Y_s: Y of s(lambda) in the normalisation above; the engine's spectrum is Y_colour / Y_s * s(lambda)

error.meaning: distance in xy between the cell and the chromaticity of its stored spectrum

flags.1: inpainted (outside the locus, or not reached)

form: s(lambda) = sigmoid(c0 t^2 + c1 t + c2); sigmoid(z) = 0.5 + z / (2 sqrt(1 + z^2)); t = (lambda - 380) / 400

grid.layout: coeffs.f32 is [iy][ix][4], iy the outer index, little-endian float32, row-major
grid.node_position: x = ix / 255, y = iy / 255 (nodes, corners included)

name: Yellowmoon spectral upsampling table

observer.name: CIE 1931 2 degree
observer.normalisation: XYZ = sum_j s(l_j) cmf(l_j) / sum_j ybar(l_j); a flat spectrum of 1 has XYZ = (1, 1, 1) to 1e-4
observer.resampling: decimation at 5 nm steps, 380..780 (exact, the source has 1 nm steps)

solver.method: Levenberg-Marquardt in CIELAB, analytic Jacobian, warm start from the nearest solved neighbour
